Replace ONLY the visible shirt/jacket and lower neckline with a black Roman clerical shirt and an unmistakable thin white clerical collar tab just below the chin. Keep the collar visible at the bottom edge without moving the face. For a beard, preserve its exact outline and put the collar naturally behind it. Keep exactly the same adult man, face, hair, beard/stubble, wrinkles, skin texture, pose, expression, gaze, head size, chin position and background. Do not recrop, zoom, reposition, stretch, beautify, smooth skin, redraw facial features or add image area. Convert the entire final photograph to natural black and white; preserve the original square composition and photographic realism. No hats, added jewelry, text, watermark, additional people, repeated anatomy, reflected padding or border. Prioritize unchanged facial anatomy over enlarging the collar.
